I enjoyed every presentation and the vibrant students. Thank You! Mr. Jonathan Gomes US Embassy One of the most enrichable campuses we have seen in the country! Best wishes to all who come here to study. আনিসুল হক সহযোগী সম্পাদক  দৈনিক প্রথম আলো ড্যাফোডিল বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় সত্যিকারের বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়। বিশ্ব+বিদ্যা+আলয় অপূর্ব। আমার মনে হচ্ছে, আহা! আমি যদি এই বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়য়ের শিক্ষার্থী হতে পারতাম । Mr. Ahsan Khan Chowdhury Chairman and CEO, PRAN-RFL Group Very nice and creative library. I'm very happy to see that the students have such a comfortable space to study. Natasha Fernando Head of marketing, SLTC Research University Elated to have experienced such an impressive library. Especially enjoyed the Bangladesh corner. Best wishes! প্রফেসর ড. মো: সাজ্জাদ হোসেন ইউজিসি মেম্বার আমি লাইব্রেরী ব্যবস্থাপনা, লোকেশন, পরিবেশ আমাকে আসলেই মুগ্ধ করেছে। এই বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের লাইব্রেরীই হবে এর মূল কেন্দ্র এই অভিপ্রায়ে এর সর্বাত্মক সাফল্য কামনা করি। Mahbubur Rahman President, ICC (Bangladesh) It is a state of the art of facility, taking into account the needs of the hour. Wonderful library and user-friendly campus. Maybe the largest one in Bangladesh. Congratulations to Sabur Khan and his smart team. Rinzin Jamtsho Member of Parliament National Assembly of Bhutan I think it is one of the cleanest, most spacious, and well-managed libraries that I have visited. Keep it up. মো: জাহাঙ্গীর হোসেন বিচারপতি, বাংলাদেশ সুপ্রীম কোর্ট উন্নত হয়েছে শিক্ষার পরিবেশ অনেক গর্ববোধ হয়েছে। শিক্ষার্থীদের আনন্দ অনেক। Brig Gen Dr. Saleem Ahmed Khan (Retd.) Managing Director, Grameen Communications Simply amazed to see a state-of-the-art of library with Alice of world-class facilities Keep goods. Dr. N.C. Talukdar Vice Chancellor, Assam Down Town University Wonderful facility coming up as a fantastic resource center for learning and human development. Thanks to the library administration showing me around. When it is full-grown within a very short time from now, it will be a very attractive center Of DIU for visitors' delight and wonder. Matiur Rahman Formar President, DCCI It’s an excellent education center in Bangladesh. In the private sector, I wish it success for a long long time. I wish if I could study at this university. Hua Sheng Zhang, Shiherg Li , Dengfei Lu , Yang Liu Sias University, China The library is very nice. Similer like chinese library. It's a good place for students to study. Bev Smith Acting Dean , Cardiff Metropolitan University,UK The library facilities are in good hands, very busy. It was a pleasure to visit. Dr. Atish Prasad Mondal Associate Professor, Department of Commerce It is a wonderful visit to the university. The library is approaching the right path to digitizing the reading materials and also preserving historical books. Mr. Mohammad Humayun Kabir Deputy Librarian , IUB I am impressed to see the wonderful library & campus. Thanks to the authority for their initiative and the unique arrangements & services of the campus. Dr. M. Abdul Aziz Director General, BIIT & Visiting Faculty, IUT I am very much impressed with its structured and creative arrangement in the library. Truly it's unique contribution to the knowledge promotion activity. Selin Yasmin Professor , MIST I am delighted to visit the campus of DIU. The library is well organized and well decorated. This type of library can easily inspire the students. I wish very sucesses of DIU. Md. Shahidul Alam Director General BMET Excellent & impressive arrangement. My proposal is that you please connect the readers to speakers through audio connectivity. Nasser Yukubu IsDB, Regional Hub Dhaka We have been taken around the school. I am impressed with the facilities and the green environment. The library is indeed a wonderful facility for the students learning. The opening hours of 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. are absolutely very convenient. Well done. A K M Mukhlesur Rahman Additional Secretory, Public Securities Division, M/O Home Affairs I am totally impressed to see the campus of the university. The facilities of education are very important, which is what is being done by this institution. Definitely, the institution and students as well will contribute to the development of the country. Toru Olcazaki Managing Director of Daffodil Japan IT Excellent system installed. This is the almost same level as Japan! Dr.Mohammad Kaykobad Distinguished Professor, CSE Dept. Brac University The DIU Library is an excellent addition to university infrastructure, where students are encouraged to spend time and consult books and journals. I am sure that in the near future, it will be enriched with many more books and journals. A.K.M Fahim Mashroor Founder and Chief Executive Officer, BDJOBS.COM এক কথায় অসাধারণ পড়াশোনার পরিবেশ , অভিভূত! দেশের স্কিল সমস্যার সমাধানে ড্যাফোডিল বিরাট ভূমিকা পালন করছে। ধন্যবাদ CDC কে আমন্ত্রণ জানানোর জন্য। Dr Rupa Vasudevan Chancellor  B.E.S.T. Innovation University, Andhra Pradesh, India Very thoughtful to take care of every aspect related to the holistic overall development of the student. Best wishes for progress and prospects. Visitor Midea Building Technology Foshan, Guangdong China Very honored to visit Daffodil University, which is a very prospective and beautiful university. Kazi Aziz Journalist, Ekattor TV Encouraging facilities at a private university library; silence is also suitable. Md. Anisul Haque Director, BGMEA "Impressed by the size of the library and study floors, seeing students sitting and studying together all the time put a nice smile on my face." Dr. Colin Patra Director, Square It is said that the journey to enlightenment starts with acquiring knowledge. At Daffodil University, you can see it in action. Col. Mr Mizanur Rahman PSC ,Bangladesh Krira Shikkha Protishtan  (BKSP) A very reachable and organized library. A source of knowledge for all students. Major Rashid Siddiq (retd) Visitor Visited DIU, a green campus! Lots of facilities are open for the students, such as a very nice and well-organized library, including the Bangladesh Corner : Study Zone, Rabindranath Knowledge Park, Napping Zone, and Library Cafe. All the facilities are beautifully decorated for students. DR. KHALEDA ISLAM Professor & Director of Institute of Nutrition and Food Science Excellent! The modern design of the library is superb. The environment is amazing, providing a perfect place for studying, with a cafe and resting area that are very nice. In the near future, there could be accommodations for individuals with disabilities. Md. Nuruzzaman Talukdar Founder Principal, Aced School, Savar The arrangement of this library is excellent. I hope that the future of the country will greatly benefit from this library. Nayna Tabassum Assistant Professor, B. Arch "The library floor is spacious, well-designed, and orderly maintained with a remarkable collection of books. I am truly impressed by the library. It would be great to introduce a digital library section with kindles and tablets, providing access to the world of information technology, such as a browsing room." জনাব মোঃ মহসিনুল হক সিনিয়র জেলা ও দায়রা জজ আজ ডি আই ইউ এর লাইব্রেরি পরিদর্শন করলাম। এর চমৎকার পরিবেশ আমাকে মুগ্ধ করেছে। বিশেষ করে ‘বঙ্গবন্ধু কর্ণার’ দেখে খুবই ভালো লাগলো। ছাত্রদের এবং শিক্ষকদের গবেষণার জন্য লাইব্রেরীর পরিবেশ সত্যিই শিক্ষা বান্ধব। আমি এই লাইব্রেরিতে এসে সত্যিই আনন্দ লাভ করেছি। সকলের জন্য শুভ কামনা রইল। Dr. Abul Basher Khan Registrar , Eastern University Excellent! The library meets international standards, and I extend my best wishes to the officials and students. Mohamad Fauzan Bin Noordin Director of IIIT, South East Asia & Professor of IIUM Good Campus, Excellent Library Dr. Nayan Talukdar Biotechnology, Faculty of Science, Assam University I am very pleased to see this 70,000 sq. ft. library at DIU. Everything is properly maintained in a sequential order. I am sure this library has a significant role in advancing human knowledge. Zaved Akhtar Chairman & Managing Director, Unilever Bangladesh Great facilities and a very conducive environment for study and research. Sami Ahmed Managing Director of Startup Bangladesh Limited A very large and well-organized infrastructure. Congratulations to DIU for developing such a facility, and I hope they will continue to advance institutions like this in Bangladesh. Prof. Ir. Dr. Wan Khairunizam Wan Ahmad Director, University Malaysia Perlis Excellent Library Md. Shahin Alam Khan Assistant Sales Manager at UniMed UniHealth Pharmaceuticals Ltd I am highly pleased to see this library. It is organized and well-equipped with resources. I propose collecting some international medical journals like 'The Lancet' for pharmacy students. Ashik Hasan Senior Manager, Human Resources at General Pharmaceuticals Ltd. I am extremely delighted to visit such a rich, tidy, organized, and resourceful library. DIU will benefit from it very soon. I would love to visit this place again and again. Good luck! Dr. Abu Reza Md. Towfiqul Islam Associate Professor and Dean of Faulty of Life and Earth Sciences "I am very happy to see the library. I suggest providing access to Scopus and Web of Science for quality research." Senem Güneysu Librarian, Istanbul Kültür University (Turkey) I really appreciate your kindness and warm welcome today. I am happy to meet you all. As a librarian from Turkey, to see such innovations and dedication in our profession is inspiring for me. Thank you all. Yasemin Baci Head of Department, Istanbul Kültür University, Library Thank you very much for everything. I look forward to our continued working friendship. Thank you for your hospitality. Muhammad Mezbah-ul-Islam, Ph.D. Professor, Department of Information Science and Library Management, It’s beyond my imagination. Hope for the best. Dr. Natta Cooper Associate Professor ,University of Waikato, New Zealand Thank you all for a wonderful visit to DIU. What a delightful campus and library. We really like it.
